title: The Holonomy of Optimal Mass Transport: The Smooth Case
summary: We prove that, on a smooth manifold $M$ equipped with a constant rank horizontal distribution $H$ and a smooth inner product $g_H$ on $H$, any horizontal vector field can be written as a linear combination of, at most, $3N$ Lie brackets of horizontal gradient fields of depth-$(1)$, where $N$ is the minimal immersion dimension of $M$, recovering the Riemannian case trivially when $H$ is the entire tangent bundle.
